title: Case System vNext task-specific strategy profiles
description: Pilot strategy profiles bound to exact archetypes and task families. Broad disciplines do not define one universal strategy policy.

profiles.strategyScope: Solving and generalizing conjugate-product structure for a learner who already knows distributive reasoning and basic symbolic manipulation.

criteria.label: Correctness
criteria.description: The reasoning and result are mathematically valid.

criteria.label: Human reasoning efficiency
criteria.description: The visible route avoids unnecessary mechanical work when an accessible structural route exists.

criteria.label: Reasoning transparency
criteria.description: The key structural move is justified at the learner's prerequisite level.

criteria.label: Generalization quality
criteria.description: When the teaching target calls for it, the response exposes and justifies the reusable identity.

constraints: Do not reward hidden model search, token brevity, or unexplained theorem invocation.
nonGoals: No claim that the shortest symbolic derivation is always pedagogically best.

profiles.strategyScope: Deriving a reusable pair-sum solution under an authored prerequisite set that includes hash maps/sets and Big-O basics.

criteria.label: Correctness
criteria.description: The algorithm solves the stated problem under the given constraints.

criteria.label: Complexity fit
criteria.description: The method avoids unnecessary pair enumeration when the allowed data structures support a better asymptotic route.

criteria.label: Insight transparency
criteria.description: The response explains why complement lookup removes one search dimension.

criteria.label: Prerequisite fit
criteria.description: The method stays inside the learner's known concepts and allowed methods.

constraints: Do not prefer a more advanced structure merely because it is more sophisticated.
nonGoals: No transfer of this profile to debugging, refactoring, systems design, or testing.

profiles.strategyScope: Designing an investigation that distinguishes competing explanations under measurement uncertainty.

criteria.label: Discriminative power
criteria.description: The design creates observations on which competing explanations make meaningfully different predictions.

criteria.label: Confound control
criteria.description: Major alternative explanations are controlled or explicitly bounded.

criteria.label: Measurement validity
criteria.description: Measurements are appropriate to the construct and their limitations are acknowledged.

criteria.label: Resource efficiency
criteria.description: Added measurements or repetitions contribute useful evidence rather than procedural volume.

constraints: More experimental steps are not automatically better or worse.
nonGoals: No assumption that one experimental design dominates when trade-offs remain non-dominated.

profiles.strategyScope: Synthesizing partially conflicting sources into an original argument while preserving evidence boundaries and uncertainty.

criteria.label: Claim coherence
criteria.description: The organizing claim or tension remains logically coherent.

criteria.label: Source integration
criteria.description: Sources are related to one another rather than serially summarized.

criteria.label: Evidence fidelity
criteria.description: The response does not overstate what sources support.

criteria.label: Uncertainty preservation
criteria.description: Real disagreement or limitation is retained rather than flattened into false consensus.

constraints: Different valid organizing structures may be equally acceptable.
nonGoals: No preference for claim-centered over tension-centered synthesis absent an authored task constraint.

profiles.strategyScope: Weighing conflicting historical or social-science sources using provenance, claims, and independent corroboration.

criteria.label: Provenance reasoning
criteria.description: Source origin, incentives, and context are used as evidence rather than as automatic authority.

criteria.label: Corroboration
criteria.description: Claims are checked against independent evidence or cross-source consistency.

criteria.label: Evidentiary weight
criteria.description: Conflicting sources are not treated as equally strong merely because they disagree.

criteria.label: Bounded conclusion
criteria.description: The conclusion matches the available evidence and leaves unresolved uncertainty explicit.

constraints: Primary-source status is not sufficient for preference.
Do not collapse disagreement into false equivalence.
nonGoals: No claim that one source type is categorically superior.
